concepts.def: For instantaneous rate on a curve

walkthroughs.body_html:
Mean rate = total change / total time.

Instantaneous rate = gradient of tangent at a point.

Energy in = bonds broken. Energy out = bonds made.

Overall = bonds broken - bonds made.

If negative -> exothermic.

Q = m x c x delta T.

For 100 g water heated by 20 C: Q = 100 x 4.2 x 20 = 8400 J.

mcqs.q: Q = m c delta T units of c are:
How does a catalyst speed up a reaction?
options: A mole is a unit of volume equal to 24 dm^3 at any temperature.
It provides an alternative reaction pathway with a lower activation energy.
A catalyst gives extra kinetic energy to the reactant particles.
A catalyst lowers the activation energy of the original reaction pathway.

mcqs.q: In an exothermic reaction, what happens energetically with the bonds?
options: A catalyst gives extra kinetic energy to the reactant particles.
Energy released forming new bonds exceeds energy absorbed breaking existing bonds.
Bond breaking releases energy and bond making absorbs energy.
The reactants get colder because they lose mass as energy.

mcqs.q: What does a mole of a substance represent?
options: The reactants get colder because they lose mass as energy.
A mole is a unit of volume equal to 24 dm^3 at any temperature.
Avogadro's number (6.02 x 10^23) of particles of that substance.
A mole is a unit of mass equal to the relative molecular mass in grams of any substance.
